registry: endpoint scope registry — proving grade, BUILD-Q-13 local build. Scopes are admitted by governed act; this file is the local build's admitted set.

ME-AGREE-01.description: Agreement receipting (BUILD-Q-49, admitted 2026-11-18 at the principal's direction): a bot or agent records an agreement it has reached — deal terms accepted by both sides — as a governed crossing at the full-evaluation tier, carrying the commit-time evidence object; the crossing issues the matched receipt pair that both sides can later verify. The crossing body's resource names the agreement being receipted (form: agreement-record:<agreement reference>).

ME-DISSOLVED-01.description: A scope whose standing receiver has been dissolved; crossings against it fail closed with NO_STANDING_RECEIVER (the W-1 post-dissolution specimen class).

ME-EVAL-01.description: Governed evaluation and receipt-pair issuance over machine-economy crossings (proving scope).
